title: The longest paper-airplane flight
value: A flight across a sunny school gym
description: A paper glider coasts from one end of a gym to the other, powered by careful folds and a well-timed launch.

title: The tallest tower of teacups
value: A teetering stack reaching a shelf
description: A patient builder balances a colorful collection of lightweight cups into a surprisingly tall tower.

title: The most socks matched in one minute
description: Quick eyes and quicker hands turn a mixed-up basket into neat pairs before the timer runs out.

title: The widest sidewalk chalk rainbow
value: A bright arc across a quiet courtyard
description: A team of artists fills a broad sweep of pavement with bands of cheerful chalk color.

title: The most paper cups stacked in a pyramid
value: A pyramid taller than its maker
description: One cup at a time, a careful stack grows into a sturdy geometric showpiece.

title: The fastest spoon to table relay
value: A speedy lap around the kitchen
description: A spoon makes a careful trip across the room in a playful relay against the clock.

title: The most tiny drawings on a sticky note
value: A miniature gallery in one square
description: A fine pen transforms a small sticky note into a dense collection of little doodles.

title: The biggest pillow fort in the living room
value: Room for a whole reading club
description: Blankets, cushions, and sofa pillows become a cozy, imaginative indoor hideaway.

title: The most reusable bottles labeled in one minute
value: A stack ready for the next adventure
description: A quick organizer adds colorful name labels to a row of reusable water bottles.

title: The longest domino trail in a hallway
value: A winding path from door to door
description: A careful line of dominoes snakes around corners, waiting for one gentle nudge.

title: The most colorful leaves collected on a walk
description: A nature walk turns up leaves in a delightful mix of shapes, shades, and textures.

title: The tallest stack of building blocks
value: A tower that nearly touches the ceiling
description: A steady builder balances bright blocks into a towering creation, one careful layer at a time.
